<script>
// Capture every wrapper event for the Playwright specs.
document.addEventListener('gsm-viz-select', function (e) {
  (window.__gsmEvents = window.__gsmEvents || []).push(e.detail);
});
</script>

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(gsm.vizr)
```

## Tiles with expandable columns

```{r tiles}
# P3 has no SBP row, so one missing cell renders. Only Pulse has detail rows,
# so only Pulse is expandable. Both frames travel column-wise.
dfTiles <- data.frame(
  subjid = c("P1", "P1", "P2", "P2", "P3"),
  vital = c("Pulse", "SBP", "Pulse", "SBP", "Pulse"),
  flag = c("Red", "Green", "Amber", NA, "Green"),
  rate = c("2/3", "0/2", "1/3", NA, "0/1")
)
dfDetail <- data.frame(
  subjid = c("P1", "P1", "P1", "P2", "P3"),
  vital = "Pulse",
  seq = c(1L, 2L, 3L, 1L, 1L),
  inWindow = c(TRUE, TRUE, FALSE, NA, FALSE),
  value = c(72, 75, NA, 80, 66)
)
tiles(
  dfTiles,
  list(
    mapping = list(x = "vital", y = "subjid", fill = "flag", label = "rate"),
    scales = list(
      y = list(order = "P3"),
      fill = list(colors = list(Green = "#3DAF06", Amber = "#FEAA02", Red = "#FF5859"))
    ),
    expand = list(
      data = dfDetail,
      mapping = list(x = "seq", fill = "inWindow", label = "value"),
      scales = list(fill = list(colors = list(true = "#B5462F", false = "#E8E8E8"))),
      tooltip = list(formatter = js_hook("function (row) { return 'detail ' + row.seq; }"))
    ),
    tooltip = list(formatter = js_hook("function (row) { return 'hook ' + row.subjid + ' ' + row.vital; }")),
    callbacks = list(
      onRowClick = js_hook(
        "function (info) { window.__rowHook = { y: info.y, self: this.id }; }"
      )
    )
  ),
  metadata = list(chartId = "chart-tiles", level = "subject")
)
```
